address: Avenida de la Ciencia 2, Granada, 18006, Spain
bio: Access to Arriaga is via a lift, given its location at the top of the Centro Cultural CajaGranada Memoria de Andalucía, a unique building that stands almost 60m in height and boasts spectacular views of the city. The cuisine here, based around two tasting menus, is an updated take on traditional cuisine inspired by local recipes but with a nod to other food cultures and painstaking presentation....
